description: This Java class 'SagePayServices' provides methods for integrating with SagePay payment gateway, including payment authentication, authorization, release, void, and refund operations. It constructs request parameters, executes HTTP POST requests, and processes responses for different payment actions.

classes.name: SagePayServices
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to handle various SagePay payment gateway operations such as authentication, authorization, release, void, and refund.

methods.name: buildSagePayProperties
methods.description: Builds and returns a map of SagePay configuration properties based on the provided context and delegator.

methods.name: paymentAuthentication
methods.description: Performs payment authentication with SagePay, constructs request parameters, executes HTTP POST, and processes the response.

methods.name: paymentAuthorisation
methods.description: Performs payment authorization with SagePay, constructs request parameters, executes HTTP POST, and processes the response.

methods.name: paymentRelease
methods.description: Releases a payment (captures funds) with SagePay, constructs request parameters, executes HTTP POST, and processes the response.

methods.name: paymentVoid
methods.description: Voids a payment with SagePay, constructs request parameters, executes HTTP POST, and processes the response.

methods.name: paymentRefund
methods.description: Refunds a payment with SagePay, constructs request parameters, executes HTTP POST, and processes the response.
